This file documents declared operations at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =session_operations=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =get-active-sessions=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: F3A62E73-083B-5DF1-BC17-5FC8C27B8275
:END:

Sends =get_active_sessions_request= and prints =get_active_sessions_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. The caller must have established a session first.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
session_operations get-active-sessions
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.ops.get_active_sessions=.

#+name: session_operations-get-active-sessions
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle session_operations-get-active-sessions.ores :exports none
session_operations get-active-sessions
#+end_src

** =end-session=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 0B5F72DD-2913-5233-96FE-CC0C5126687A
:END:

Sends =end_session_request= and prints =end_session_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. It reads =session_id=, in that order. The caller must have established a session first.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
session_operations end-session <session_id>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.ops.end_session=.

#+name: session_operations-end-session
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle session_operations-end-session.ores :exports none
session_operations end-session 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
#+end_src
